assumptions.statement: Shared components drift quickly, within weeks of each release
assumptions.quote: Shared components drift within weeks of every release.

assumptions.statement: Continuous integration pipelines can rely on remote caching to keep build times acceptable
assumptions.quote: CI must use remote caching to stay fast.

assumptions.statement: A single pull request can update a component and propagate the change to all consuming applications
assumptions.quote: one pull request can change a component and every consumer.
